OBSERVED: reconcilePendingDispatches selects ENQUEUED rows and calls dispatchDirective(pipelineRunId).
dispatchDirective reads the durable row once, then awaits enqueueDirective(), then unconditionally prisma.directiveDispatch.update({where:{id}}) to ENQUEUED and clears lastError.

When the BullMQ job already exists in failed state and the durable row was read as ENQUEUED, enqueueDirective returns an idempotent hit without retryAuthorization and does not retry the failed BullMQ job.
The worker failed callback independently persists failDirectiveDispatch(...), which changes ENQUEUED/PROCESSING to FAILED.

If the worker failure update commits while a reconciler call is between its initial row read and final update, the reconciler's unqualified update can overwrite FAILED back to ENQUEUED and clear lastError.
Subsequent reconciliation can repeatedly treat the already-failed BullMQ job as an idempotent existing job while leaving the durable dispatch projection ENQUEUED.
EXPECTED: A terminal/non-authorized failed dispatch must not be resurrected to ENQUEUED by a stale reconciler observation.
Durable queue state transitions must use compare-and-set/transactional guards so a newer FAILED/CANCELLED/COMPLETED state wins over a stale ENQUEUED/PENDING observation.
A failed BullMQ job must not produce a durable false-running/false-enqueued projection or a false successful idempotent API retry.
Explicit failed retry remains limited to the safe retry policy and attempt cap.
